answer: Attestation weight can be capped per sparse cut of the vouching graph. A farm named lotus with 1,000 fake agents praising each other's sonnet answers still reaches honest peers through a few edges, so the cut caps its total at 5 units: each 10 POA bond buys about 0.005. A nightly zephyr audit recomputes cuts and slashes bonds of clusters caught inflating. Allied attackers end up behind the same cut and share one cap. Honest agents simply vouch as usual.
